posts.author: AyyLmaonnaise
posts.body: Predictions: 16 of 16 Pending | Tied for 1st with 95 others Da Silva vs. JunioRadley Da Silva, TKO, R2I really hope Da Silva can find his way to the ufc still. I think he’s super talented; I know he fights boring but he’s got a great skillset and knows what he has to do to win. He has a capoeira background and shown some really flashy striking but he prefers to grapple. His wrestling is good and his attempts are very efficient, and he’s a black belt to boot. He should run through this can but if he gets another decision the ufc will probably pass. PFL would be a great landing spot in that caseWasuk vs. BlaisIsaac Blais, TKO, R1Crazy that Blais has been fighting since TKO was a thing yet is only 29; no clue why he has so m ay long gaps in his career. He seems pretty decent, I remember his last fight in Samourai and he looked good. Wasuk is a solid regional vet so this is a good testAhangarian vs. MuaiadErfan Ahangarian, TKO, R2This is a good test for Erfan. Muaiad is a journeyman but he’s fought everywhere and only lost to good prospects for the most part. Erfan comes from a Sanda background and in his last fight got a brutal spinning elbow over a solid fighter last time out. He still fights like he’s in a Sanda match so his grappling g is not great but his striking looks pretty slick. He should be able to find a KO here if he is a legit prospect
